title: Data and Approaches for German Text simplification – towards an Accessibility-enhanced Communication

bias_targets.methodology: Categorizing 14 parallel German text simplification datasets by target audience to quantify the proportion of children-oriented data (20%), identifying it as a source of bias when training models intended for adults with cognitive impairments.

Systematically assessing the landscape of parallel and monolingual German text corpora to evaluate the lack of domain-specific data (e.g., legal texts) and structural features (e.g., illustrations, specialized layouts) needed to serve people with language or cognitive disabilities.
